scope: Mapped allocator checkpoint before final file-result copy removal

notes: Sampling at completed-cycle boundaries; peaks during cycles require separate instrumentation.
RSS contains library caches and allocator arenas; trend thresholds trigger investigation, not proof of absence of leaks.
Socket count includes cached connections; native HTTP readiness registrations do not count all pooled idle connections.
Active Tasks count scheduled Fibers, not arbitrary application-created Fibers.
